criteria.criterion: The owner/admin pages for an appliance, customer, rental agreement, purchase, seller, visit and invoice each show a Related panel listing the connected records (for example an appliance's purchase, seller, rentals, visits and repair requests) as plain-worded links to pages that exist.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/connections/index.ts (getRecordConnections, owner/admin only) and src/components/desk/record-connections.tsx are on the appliance, customer, agreement, purchase, seller, visit and invoice pages; tests/w17-connections-integration.test.ts checks the links for all seven kinds and that staff are refused.

criteria.criterion: The same seven pages show a History timeline, newest first, built from the activity log, saying what happened, who did it and when in plain words with no raw codes.
criteria.evidence: The same component shows History from the activity log, newest first, with who, when and a plain-words action (plainAction never shows a raw code); the appliance page keeps its fuller timeline and now shows who; tests/w17-connections.test.ts and the integration test check the wording and the order.

criteria.criterion: Search finds purchases by seller name or receipt number and sellers by name for owner and admin only (never for staff), and keeps finding appliances by serial number and model.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/search/index.ts adds purchases (seller name, receipt number, seller) and sellers for owner/admin only; tests/w17-connections.test.ts proves staff never run those queries and the integration test proves serial-number search still works.

criteria.criterion: A passed inspection moves the appliance to a new Cleaning status instead of straight to Available, Cleaning shows on Today as a To do with a working button, and "Cleaning done" makes it Available.
criteria.evidence: ApplianceStatus gains CLEANING (migration 20261017170000), a passed inspection goes there, listCleaningNeeded puts 'Clean (machine)' on Today linking to the appliance, and markCleaningDone (owner/admin, locked, audited, repeat-safe) makes it Available; proven in tests/w17-connections-integration.test.ts and tests/lifecycle.test.ts.

criteria.criterion: A failed inspection drafts exactly one unscheduled repair visit for that appliance and moves it to In repair, and a repeat creates no second visit.
criteria.evidence: recordApplianceInspection calls ensureRepairDraftInTx on a fail: one undated repair visit, reused on a repeat, shown on Today as 'Schedule the repair'; proven by the second integration test (a second failed inspection leaves exactly one).

criteria.criterion: Portal home and Billing show "Your next bill" for each current rental: the rent for the appliances now on it, the date, and a plain note that tax and credits are shown on the bill itself, in English and Spanish.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/portal/next-bill.ts sums the rent of each current rental with its next billing date, shown by NextBillCard on portal home and Billing with the tax-and-credits note in English and Spanish; tests/w20-portal.test.ts checks the total and the Spanish text.

criteria.criterion: An overdue, unpaid invoice that has a Stripe payment page shows a "Pay now" button on the customer's invoice page and in the billing list that opens that invoice's own Stripe-hosted page; only the signed-in customer's own invoices work, nothing is offered for paid or closed invoices, and local invoices keep "Pay as arranged".
criteria.evidence: src/domains/portal/pay-now.ts and the POST route /account/billing/invoice/[invoiceId]/pay open the invoice's own Stripe page only for the signed-in customer's overdue payable Stripe invoice; the Pay now button is on the invoice page and the billing list; tests/w20-portal.test.ts and the integration test prove someone else's, paid and local invoices get nothing.

criteria.criterion: The customer's open delivery, pickup and repair visits each show a short status timeline in plain words (requested, scheduled for a date, done) on the portal home.
criteria.evidence: OpenVisits on portal home shows Requested, Scheduled (date or 'Not scheduled yet') and Done for each open visit from getPortalHome; labels have Spanish text checked in tests/w20-portal.test.ts.

criteria.criterion: After the customer asks for a pickup, reports a problem or ends a rental, the page says in plain words what happens next, in English and Spanish.
criteria.evidence: The problem-report confirmation, the ending-a-rental note on My rentals and the existing pickup confirmation say what happens next, in English and Spanish (portal-copy.ts; tests/w20-portal.test.ts checks the new Spanish entries).

criteria.criterion: A package line shows as a set, for example "Washer + Dryer Set (washer #A12, dryer #B07)", on portal home and My rentals.
criteria.evidence: src/domains/portal/line-display.ts shows a package line as 'Washer + Dryer Set (washer #A12, dryer #B07)' on portal home and My rentals; tests/w20-portal.test.ts checks the exact wording.

planComparison: Actual production change is about +715/-25 lines, inside the 900-line estimate and the 400-800 guide. Both subsections, their boundaries and all frozen acceptance are unchanged and fully delivered. One extra rule was needed and is covered by an existing test: the custody rules now treat the new Cleaning status as 'in the shop'. Visual redesign work was not started.
newEngineering: Connected-records domain and panel on seven pages, appliance history with who and plain wording, purchase and seller search, Cleaning status (additive migration), Cleaning done action and To do, failed-inspection single repair draft and its To do, custody rule for Cleaning, portal next bill, Pay now rules and POST route, visit timelines, package set display, next-step notes with Spanish copy, 19 new tests and 3 updated tests
relatedWorkDecision: W-17 and W-20 are the last two items of Batch W in approved order. The portal work reads the same records W-17 connects, so they share one review. Pay now only opens Stripe's own hosted page for an invoice the signed-in customer owns; it moves no money in this app.
